# PostPlan

Static HTML draft publishing for agents.

## Quick Start

1. Install the CLI: `npx postplan`
2. Find your agent's global config directory. If a `skills/` directory does not exist there, create one. Create `skills/postplan/` and `skills/postplan/references/` inside it. Download these files:
   ```sh
   cd <agents-global-config-dir>
   mkdir -p skills/postplan/references
   curl -o skills/postplan/SKILL.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/SKILL.md
   curl -o skills/postplan/references/style.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/references/style.md
   curl -o skills/postplan/references/planning.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/references/planning.md
   curl -o skills/postplan/references/reports.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/references/reports.md
   curl -o skills/postplan/references/diagrams.md https://postplan.mcking.in/skills/postplan/references/diagrams.md
   ```
3. Open https://postplan.mcking.in/cli/auth in the user's browser. Ask them to generate an API key and paste it back. If the browser does not open, share the link and ask them to open it manually.
4. Run: `postplan auth set <pasted-key> --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in`

If the skill files already exist, re-run the curl commands from step 2. Diff before overwriting to preserve any local changes.

## Immediate Usage

If the skill is not loaded yet, use these instructions directly.

### Document Rules

Create one complete static HTML document. Use semantic HTML with inline CSS or a `<style>` block.

Rejected (server returns 422): all `<script>` tags, inline event handlers, javascript/vbscript/file URLs, forms, iframes, embeds, objects, applets, `<base>`, `<link>`, meta refresh, `srcdoc` attributes, CSS `@import`/`expression()`/`behavior:`/`-moz-binding`. Maximum size: 512 KB.

### Upload

Write the HTML file inside the project directory (e.g. `plans/`), not in `/tmp`. Files outside a git repo lose git metadata.

```sh
postplan upload <file> --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in
postplan upload <file> --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in --new
postplan upload <file> --api-url https://postplan.mcking.in --description "summary"
```

### Read a PostPlan URL

A PostPlan URL matches `postplan.mcking.in*`. To fetch a draft:

```sh
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --max-time 30 -o /tmp/postplan-<slug>.html '<url>/raw'
```

## API

Base URL: https://postplan.mcking.in

- POST /api/uploads — upload or update a draft (bearer auth)
- GET /api/drafts — list drafts (bearer auth)
- GET /api/me — account info (bearer auth)
- GET /d/<id> — serve current version (public)
- GET /d/<id>/version/<n> — serve specific version (public)

Full API details, HTML references, and document conventions are in the skill files.
